Many will remember the name of Scott Wyld as a young Belgravian with a lot of promise in the jumping events. Scott left when we couldn't provide any appropriate Age Group competition (a lesson for us there) but he returns from Herne Hill as a multi-disciplined jumper with a best Long Jump of 7.23w.
